metrics_categories.description: Metrics used to benchmark each scoring function's ability to classify the 1671 homodimer interfaces as physiological or crystallographic: two threshold-free ranking metrics (AUC-ROC, AUCPR) and three threshold-based metrics (Accuracy, Balanced Accuracy, F1 Score, MCC) evaluated at the published threshold reported for that scoring function, or at a data-driven optimal threshold (Youden's J statistic) when no published threshold exists.

Combines pairs of metrics (AUC-ROC vs. Accuracy, AUC-ROC vs. AUCPR, Balanced Accuracy vs. F1 Score, MCC vs. Balanced Accuracy) of all participating scoring functions into four complementary 2D challenge leaderboards.

name: Discrimination of physiological vs. non-physiological (crystallographic) homodimer interfaces
